title: HIVEM1ND 3.0: start working
note: From the owner's sketch: the person at the center of the Map, everything empty at first, repositories offered and imported as clusters, a cluster linked to a repository, a folder or nothing, agents created inside clusters, and the Overseer created first, fresh in each session. A separate board from the 3.0 screen flow. The sample is invented.

replies.author: User
replies.text: Esto no está preparado muy bien si hay muchos repos y muchos environments...

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Redone for many folders and repositories: the found repositories are grouped by the folder that holds them (Web 19, Unity 6, Tools 1), with a filter, one tick per folder and the repositories inside. Each folder becomes a cluster linked to it, with its repositories as clusters inside; worktrees stay inside their repository. New screens 1.3 All clusters and 1.4 Inside a folder cluster (double click opens it, All clusters goes back).

replies.author: User
replies.text: Compact or Clear. "Keep going" no, poner una X arriba a la derecha

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Done: the notice offers Compact (keeps a summary) and Clear (starts empty); Keep going is gone and an X at the top right closes it.

replies.author: overmind-hivem1nd
replies.text: Drawn in 2.4: Runs in opens one picker with three columns, agent with its remaining quota, model and effort.
